description: In every PA-model, an arithmetic graph with PA-provable uniform totality and uniqueness determines exactly one function of the specified arity.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.graph_function_unique.{u} {n : ℕ}
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (hφ :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.totalUnique φ))
  {M : Type u} [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] :
  ∃! f, ∀ (x : Fin n → M), φ.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x (f x))
